units.source_text: 这双掌，至今我仍记忆犹新。

en.t: Even now, I still remember those two palms vividly.

units.source_text: 那是双无与伦比的巨掌。

en.t: They were a pair of incomparable enormous palms.

units.source_text: 它是从我背后绕过来，突然捂住我的眼睛，把我所看到的地狱遮盖起来了。

en.t: They came around from behind me, suddenly covered my eyes, and shut out the hell I had been seeing.
These were the enormous palms of the world to come.

units.source_text: 不知是出于爱、慈悲还是屈辱，好歹即时中断了我所接触到的可怕的世界，并将它完全埋葬在黑暗之中。

en.t: Whether it was out of love, compassion, or humiliation, they somehow immediately broke off the terrifying world I had touched and buried it completely in darkness.
